about.title: ABOUT SOPHIA
description: Sophia brings over 8 years of experience in event design and management. Her creativity, leadership, and strategic planning ensure every event we create is unique, seamless, and truly memorable.
From luxury weddings to corporate galas, Sophia's innovative concepts and meticulous execution have earned her the trust of clients and the respect of her peers.
